counterexample_moisture.explanation: water adds mass but the fibre skeleton sets the stress-strain response; pressure and fill are identical while mass differs by 20 %

counterexample_material_stiffness.explanation: a stiffer batch at the same face stress and fill is lighter; pressure alone cannot tell softer-heavier from stiffer-lighter without the material law of that batch

observation_rank.what_resolves_it: a direct gravitational measurement (load cells/strain at ALL supports) or per-batch density reference (ticket anchors only fix the machine mean)

hooklift_com.formula: m_hat/m = x_c / x_c_hat  (single force about one pivot)
hooklift_com.explanation: one force about one pivot measures W*x_c, not W; a second reaction is needed
